problem_statement: README.txt: UIC Kit - Smart Road Compaction Interface Project Overview The UIC Kit is an industrial Human-Machine Interface (HMI) designed for heavy road rollers. It transforms complex mechanical vibration data into a simple, color-coded geospatial map. This system ensures road quality (ground stiffness) is deterministic and verifiable, rather than estimated by the operator.
challenges: Handling edge cases in high-frequency data inputs.
outcomes: Successful deployment and verification of the Nhai App Demo system.
lessons_learned: Iterative unit testing is critical when dealing with physical sensors.
